criterion: L6 - the printable summary the live app itself produces does not mention the South Asian context
how: On the production page, after a real analysis, the browser's print() was stubbed before clicking 'Printable summary' so no print dialog opened. The app writes the summary into a hidden iframe and calls print() on it; the stub recorded the call and captured that iframe's own document, which is exactly the HTML the app would have printed.
note: The positive controls matter: without them an empty or failed capture would pass every absence check.
